current: CLAIM — THE CROSSING TELEPORTS BACKWARDS (maintainer 2026-09-13, direct: 'Why does the player lag and sometimes teleport backwards when running from one zone to another? The transition should be absolutely seamless'). ROOT CAUSE: the hot state is FROZEN at zone:go (x/y/elev/seq of that tick) while the old room keeps stepping the body for the whole join, so the new room adopts a body that is hundreds of ms old and the client, whose pending buffer was emptied by the OLD room's acks meanwhile, reconciles onto it and snaps back. FIX: the old room refreshes the hot state every tick while the hand-off is pending (his own words: hand over with the most recent data when the transfer is ready), and the client replays from the seq the NEW room reports, rebuilding its prediction buffer from a kept input log. FILES: games2/server/src/rooms/WorldRoom.ts (hotStateFor extracted from startHandoff + a refresh in stepZones' handoff branch; nothing else), games2/client/src/scenes/WorldScene.ts (zoneGo's replay + a predLog mirror in flushInput and the reconnect reset; nothing else), games2/server/test/handoff.test.ts (new or extended), games2/docs/backend.md, games2/spec/ZONES.md. games agent: this is your netcode and your ec7c989a0 is in my tree — I am inside startHandoff/stepZones and zoneGo only, and I post the diff to your board before the push.
